mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, user_id, user_name, dept_id, dept_name, sku_no, product_name, use_user_id, use_user_name, qty

SELECT sl.id as sampleLedgerId, sl.user_id AS userId, sl.user_name AS userName, sl.dept_id AS deptId, sl.dept_name AS deptName, sl.sku_id AS skuId, sl.sku_no AS skuNo, sl.product_name AS productName, sl.use_user_id AS useUserId, sl.use_user_name AS useUserName,
COALESCE(sl.qty, 0) - COALESCE(dd.freezeQty, 0) AS availableQty
sl.qty AS availableQty
FROM sample_ledger sl
left join ( select ssd.sku_id , sum(ssd.scrap_qty) as freezeQty from sample_scrap_info ssi inner join sample_scrap_detail ssd on ssi.id = ssd.main_id and ssd.is_deleted = false where ssi.is_deleted = false and ssi.approve_status !='approve'
and ssi.id != #{params.childId}
GROUP BY ssd.sku_id) as dd on dd.sku_id = sl.sku_id
left join ( select ssd.sku_id , sum(ssd.borrow_qty) as freezeQty from sample_borrow_info ssi inner join sample_borrow_detail ssd on ssi.id = ssd.main_id and ssd.is_deleted = false where ssi.is_deleted = false and ssi.approve_status !='approve'
and ssi.id != #{params.childId}
GROUP BY ssd.sku_id ) as dd on dd.sku_id = sl.sku_id
WHERE sl.is_deleted = FALSE AND sl.user_id = #{ params.userId}
and sl.sku_no in
#{item}
and sl.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.skuNo}::text,'%')
order by sl.sku_no desc
mapper.select:
SELECT 'all' as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM sample_ledger sl WHERE sl.is_deleted = FALSE
AND sl.qty != 0
AND (${permissionSql})
